column4: Refer to blood donors who donate blood for the first time.
Refer to blood donors who make two or more blood donations in a year.
Refer to blood donors who are 16 to 25 years old.

Refer to blood donations at Bloodbank@Health Sciences Authority, Bloodbank@Woodlands (from January 2011), Bloodbank@Dhoby Ghaut  (from September 2012), Bloodbank@Westgate Tower (from June 2015), Bloodbank@One Punggol (from August 2023) and blood mobiles.  Each blood donor can make one or more blood donations in a year.
